description: Senator Marty has been leading the fight against climate change in the Minnesota Senate. Because it is the biggest single threat to the future of society, John continues pushing for legislation to put a price on greenhouse gas emissions, to strengthen our use of renewable energy in every sector of the economy, and to keep fossil fuels in the ground.

title: Climate Change | John Marty for Senate
